ignoreValues.reason: Claude decided: the island's width/height morph is the core interaction; the native window is resized on every state change anyway, which relayouts the whole page, and the island's children are absolutely positioned with fixed widths so nothing reflows
Claude decided: .dots is the owl's thinking indicator, shown only while a speech-to-text or chat-model request is in flight, so the motion is tied to live state
Claude decided: the flagged div is #island, whose only child is the #clip mask (inset 0); text inset comes from each view's own padding (#expanded 12px 20px, #compact 0 18px 0 12px)
